title: Week 05 - Factors, Multiples, and Prime Numbers
description: Practice multiple checks, factor enumeration, prime checks, greatest common factors, and least common multiples.

questions.title: Check Whether One Number Is a Multiple of Another
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Simple

## Background

In a school activity, some numbers need to be grouped by a fixed interval. If a number can be divided evenly by base, it is a multiple of base.

## Task

Determine whether number is a multiple of base.

## Input

Two numbers: number and base.

## Output

Return true if number is a multiple of base; otherwise return false.

## Hint

You can observe the remainder after division.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(number, base)
    if number % base == 0 then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

questions.title: Check Whether a Team Can Be Split into Equal Groups
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Simple

## Background

In PE class there are people students, and the teacher wants to split them evenly into groups of groupSize students each.

## Task

Determine whether these students can be split into equal groups with no one left over.

## Input

Two numbers: people and groupSize.

## Output

Return true if they can be split evenly; otherwise return false.

## Hint

Equal grouping means no student can be left over.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(people, groupSize)
    if people % groupSize == 0 then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

questions.title: Count Multiples of a Target Number from 1 to n
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Simple

## Background

The teacher gives a target number k and asks students to find all multiples of k from 1 to n.

## Task

Count how many numbers from 1 to n are multiples of k.

## Input

Two numbers: n and k.

## Output

Return the count of multiples of k.

## Hint

Check each number one by one against the multiple rule.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(n, k)
    local count = 0

    for i = 1, n do
        if i % k == 0 then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end

    return count
end

questions.title: Find How Many Equal-Sharing Methods a Puzzle Block Count Has
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Normal

## Background

A puzzle box has blocks pieces. The teacher wants to know how many different group counts can divide these puzzle pieces evenly.

## Task

Count the number of factors of blocks.

## Input

One positive integer: blocks.

## Output

Return the number of possible group counts that can divide the blocks evenly.

## Hint

You can try each possible group count one by one.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(blocks)
    local count = 0

    for i = 1, blocks do
        if blocks % i == 0 then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end

    return count
end

questions.title: Count How Many Factors a Special Number Has
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Normal

## Background

In a game, a special number needs to be checked to see how many positive integers can divide it evenly.

## Task

Count the number of factors of number.

## Input

One positive integer: number.

## Output

Return the number of factors of number.

## Hint

A factor must divide the original number evenly.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(number)
    local count = 0

    for i = 1, number do
        if number % i == 0 then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end

    return count
end

questions.title: Calculate the Count and Sum of All Factors of a Number
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Normal

## Background

The teacher wants to know not only how many factors a number has, but also what those factors add up to.

## Task

Count the factors of number and calculate the sum of all factors.

## Input

One positive integer: number.

## Output

Return the factor count and factor sum in order.

## Hint

After finding a factor, you can update both the count and the sum.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(number)
    local count = 0
    local sum = 0

    for i = 1, number do
        if number % i == 0 then
            count = count + 1
            sum = sum + i
        end
    end

    return count, sum
end

questions.title: Check Whether a Special Number Is Prime
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Challenge

## Background

In a game, a prime number is a number that has exactly two factors.

## Task

Determine whether number is prime.

## Input

One positive integer: number.

## Output

Return true if it is prime; otherwise return false.

## Hint

You can count the factors first, then decide the number type from that count.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(number)
    local factorCount = 0

    for i = 1, number do
        if number % i == 0 then
            factorCount = factorCount + 1
        end
    end

    if factorCount == 2 then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

questions.title: Find the Largest Common Group Size for Two Classes
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Challenge

## Background

Two classes have classA and classB students. The teacher wants both classes to be split evenly into groups and wants each group to be as large as possible.

## Task

Find the greatest common factor of classA and classB.

## Input

Two positive integers: classA and classB.

## Output

Return the largest common group size.

## Hint

Try all possible group sizes and keep the largest valid one found so far.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(classA, classB)
    local best = 1

    for i = 1, classA do
        if classA % i == 0 and classB % i == 0 then
            best = i
        end
    end

    return best
end

questions.title: Find the First Minute When Two Alarms Ring Together
questions.description:
## Difficulty

Challenge

## Background

Two alarms start timing at the same moment. The first rings every a minutes, and the second rings every b minutes. We need to find the first time when they ring together.

## Task

Find the least common multiple of a and b.

## Input

Two positive integers: a and b.

## Output

Return the first minute when the two alarms ring together.

## Hint

Start trying from smaller times and find the first time that matches both cycles.
questions.reference_code:
function solution(a, b)
    local answer = 0

    for i = 1, a * b do
        if answer == 0 and i % a == 0 and i % b == 0 then
            answer = i
        end
    end

    return answer
end
